e2e.auth_notes: The actor is the seeded student 小明 (course 1 enrolled, has_exam 0 — the only enrollment listed on the selected-courses page), whose credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Dropping course 1 deletes the student_course (1,24) row. No balance refund happens (upstream behavior — the price is not returned). Course 1 is the only has_exam=0 enrollment; course 4 is completed and only listed on the over-courses page, which has no drop widget. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
